rationale: A controller-specific duration reserve is a distinct immutable bound: it preserves time for controller lifecycle work rather than admitting more wave work. Its name is direct, uses established controller vocabulary, and has the required explicit seconds unit.
alternatives: merge with wave_reserve_seconds: conflates controller lifecycle time with wave capacity
remove: loses an explicit duration bound needed for safe controller scheduling
simplestChoice: Keep controller_reserve_seconds as the controller lifecycle duration reserve.
